simple.meaning: זוּעַ (zûwaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “to shake (with fear).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: זוּעַ (H2112) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 5:19, with occurrences in Daniel.

simple.summary: זוּעַ (zûwaʻ) / H2112 is traced through Daniel 5:19, Daniel 6:27 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

occurrences.englishText: Because of the greatness that he gave him, all the peoples, nations, and languages trembled and feared before him. He killed whom he wanted to, and he kept alive whom he wanted to. He raised up whom he wanted to, and he put down whom he wanted to.
